title: A maximal-envelope reduction for affine parabolic intersections
exact_target: In an Artin group, a standard parabolic subgroup is generated by a subset of the standard generators, and a parabolic subgroup is a conjugate of such a subgroup. Must an intersection of two parabolic subgroups again be parabolic? In particular, does this hold for Artin groups of Euclidean type?
